primary_title: Semrush Sets New Standard for Digital Brand Visibility with Spotlight 2026 Conference
summary: Semrush (SEMR) announced its Spotlight 2026 marketing conference, scheduled for October 13 in London. The event is positioned as a key catalyst for the company, focusing on strategies for brand visibility in the evolving AI search landscape.
